messages.subject: reading-is-slow-reg.
parts:
Hi ROR team,

Kudos for integrating MKL for window version.

However, I observed with five different csv files that 'read.csv' is slow and some times even hanging for small MB files. Strange part is no error, but taking unusual times than orginal R version.

My version details:
OS: Windows 8.1 Pro
R: 3.1.1
ROR: Beta 8
RAM: 16 GB

Regrads.
Dr. Pradeep Mavuluri.

messages.author: 0eb5a09fd4de9e5e
messages.subject: Re: reading-is-slow-reg.
parts:
Hi, Pradeep

Thank you for testing RRO and reporting your experience.

I have tried to replicate your findings.  On my Windows laptop I imported a 127MB file using read.csv() with standard settings.

I use this code:

datafile <- "f:/airlines/1987.csv"

system.time({
  dat <- read.csv(datafile)
})

The timings on my machine are virtually identical between open R and RRO:

   user  system elapsed 
  15.21    0.55   16.16 

   user  system elapsed 
  16.11    0.71   16.82 


Perhaps something unusual happened during your installation.  Could you please try to uninstall, then get the latest installer at http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/download/ and try again?

I'm sorry I can't be of more help, but please let me know if you continue to experience this problem.

Regards

Andrie
